art_direction_concept: 少人数でストウブ無水料理を学ぶ料理教室。を、申込み前の疑問をほどくの入口として見せる。
visual_mood: open studio energy with tools, hands and an invitation to try

color_logic.reason: PERSON is the first evidence-bearing authority.

typography_logic: Large meaning-unit headlines, compact labels, readable Japanese body text.
composition_logic: A studio-table opening, shared-tool evidence surface and session path; the page invites a first try rather than listing a menu.
photography_logic: Role-driven photography is the primary visual authority; vector scenes are support only.

replacement_targets: 実店舗・実現場・実商品・実人物写真
layout_constraints: 同一役割の実写真を同じ比率へ差し替え可能
photo_replacement_readiness.proof_role: visual_context_only; not evidence of a real result or location

icon_logic: No generic icon wall; use line markers tied to the process sequence.
texture_logic: Subtle ruled-paper and calibration marks, never a decorative grain overlay.
motion_logic: open_the_session; one restrained reveal per section; no infinite or blocking animation.
craft_catch: A session mark carries the customer from curiosity to a first activity they can name.

art_direction_dimensions.crop_logic: no client image dependency; abstract geometry carries the role

roles.visual_subject: 手を動かしながら学ぶ共有時間
roles.business_purpose: 完成品だけでなく教室体験を伝える
roles.replacement_target: 実教室・レッスン風景

roles.visual_subject: 食材・道具・下準備の手触り
roles.business_purpose: 素材への関心と暮らしの温度を伝える

roles.visual_subject: 包丁・混ぜる・盛り付け等の手元
roles.business_purpose: 学びの具体性を見せる
体験後の達成感を想起させる
roles.replacement_target: 実教室の完成物・食卓
